overview: Criminal Law is the field concerned with Crimes and punishments: what society forbids and how it responds. The Future of Criminal Law belongs to its essential core. Concretely: Inchoate crimes — attempt, conspiracy, and solicitation punishing dangerous steps. And Procedure — the rights of the accused from arrest through appeal. Mastering this entry means being able to explain the topic in plain sentences, recognize it in real cases, and apply it alongside the neighboring ideas of the Advanced tier.

Procedure: the rights of the accused from arrest through appeal.
key_laws: Presumption of innocence: the accused need prove nothing.
